id.description: The unique identifier of the knowledge base

slug.description: The URL-friendly slug for the knowledge base

title.description: The title of the knowledge base

description.description: A brief description of the knowledge base

status.description: The status of the knowledge base

deleteError.description: The error message if deletion fails

files.description: The number of files in the knowledge base

storage.description: The total storage used by the knowledge base in bytes

tenantId.description: The ID of the tenant this knowledge base belongs to

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the knowledge base was created

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the knowledge base was last updated
